verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents alerting on log patterns and generic 'timely notifications', plus an MCP server and Agent Skills that let agents manage alerts. None of it documents registrable outbound webhook notification channels that could trigger automated remediation or agents. Alert management via MCP is an adjacent, inbound-to-SigNoz capability, not an outbound webhook callback, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point alert notifications at webhooks that trigger automated remediation or agents
